summary:
Bullpen_fatigue is the story of the week across every rating — R1 through R4 all sit at 68-84% over the last 14 days with 5-game win streaks, a swing of +21.8 to +32.1 points over season baseline. Hitting isn't far behind, with R4 hitting 16-3 (84%, n=19) and R2/R3 both running 74% with their own 4-game streaks. When a model's weakest season-long category (bullpen_fatigue sits in the 46-47% range for the year across all four ratings) suddenly flips to a league-best short-term trend, that's the signal worth leaning into today, especially stacked with bullpen proper, which is hot across the board too (55-63% last 14, +5.8 to +8.5pts, 4-game streaks everywhere). All four ratings are also cashing strong plays at elite clips in the last 30 days — R1 67% (+36.0u), R2 65% (+35.0u), R3 66% (+33.0u), R4 67% (+42.0u) — so the model's "high confidence" tier is printing right now.

On today's four-game board, full consensus across R1-R4 gives a clean read: LAD @ ATL is the strongest signal of the day, with all four ratings leaning LAD by -0.88 to -1.16, and LAD happens to be a team-when-liked monster (70% hit, strong plays 27-7 at 79%, +26.0u) — this is about as good as the model's trust list gets. CLE @ CHW is nearly as clean on the other side, unanimous CHW at +0.72 to +1.00, the tightest grouping of deltas on the slate, which usually means multiple categories are agreeing underneath. TBR @ NYY gives consensus NYY, but treat it cautiously — NYY picks have been a coin flip all year (50%, n=46) and actively bleed money on strong plays (-4.0u, 39% hit), the one red flag on the board, especially against a TBR team that rewards being backed (70%, strong 72%, +22.0u) when the model likes them instead. MIL @ SDP leans MIL but with the softest deltas of the day (-0.36 to -0.67), and MIL's own profile (66% hit, strong 68%, +17.0u) is solid but not as explosive as LAD's — worth a look, not a max play. With bullpen_fatigue and hitting both running hot, keep an eye on which of these four games lean on those categories specifically; that's where today's edge over the raw consensus signal lives.
